sents.t: Does being happy make you less successful?
sents.zh: 开心会让人没那么成功吗？

sents.t: That is conventional wisdom, that may even be the practical earned experience of your reality.
sents.zh: 这是普遍的看法，甚至可能就是你在现实中亲身得来的实际经验。

sents.t: You find that when you’re happy you don’t want anything so you don’t get up and do anything.
sents.zh: 你会发现，人一开心就什么都不想要了，所以也就不会起身去做任何事。

sents.t: On the other hand, you still gotta do something.
sents.zh: 可另一方面，你总还是得做点什么。

sents.t: You’re an animal, you’re here to survive, you’re here to replicate, you’re driven, you’re motivated, you’re gonna do something.
sents.zh: 你是动物，你来这世上是为了生存、为了繁衍，你有驱动力，你有动力，你总会去做点什么的。

sents.t: You’re not just gonna sit there all day.
sents.zh: 你不会就那么整天坐着不动。

sents.t: Some people do, maybe it’s in their nature, but I think most people still want to act, they want to live in the arena.
sents.zh: 有些人确实会，也许那就是他们的天性，但我觉得大多数人还是想行动，想亲自上场。

sents.t: I found for myself as I’ve become happier—is a big word, but you know, more peaceful, more calm, more present, more satisfied with what I have—
sents.zh: 我自己发现，随着我变得更快乐——“快乐”这个词有点大，但你懂的，就是更平和、更冷静、更活在当下、对自己拥有的更满足——

sents.t: I still want to do things, I just want to do bigger things.
sents.zh: 我还是想做事，只是想做更大的事。

sents.t: I want to do things that are more pure, more aligned with what I think needs to be done and what I can uniquely do.
sents.zh: 我想做更纯粹的事，更符合我认为需要做的、也是只有我才做得了的事。

sents.t: So in that sense I think that being happier can actually make you more successful, but your definition of success will likely change along the way.
sents.zh: 所以从这个意义上说，我觉得更快乐其实能让你更成功，只不过一路走下来，你对成功的定义很可能会变。

sents.t: Is that a realization you think you could have gotten to had you not had some success in the first place?
sents.zh: 你觉得，如果当初没有先取得一些成功，你还能领悟到这一点吗？

sents.t: At least for me, I always wanted to take the path of material success first.
sents.zh: 至少对我来说，我一直想先走物质成功这条路。

sents.t: I was not going to go be an ascetic and sit there and renounce everything. That just seems too unrealistic and too painful.
sents.zh: 我不会去当苦行僧，坐在那儿放弃一切。那太不现实，也太痛苦了。

sents.t: In the story of Buddha, he starts out as a prince and then he sees that it’s all kind of meaningless because you’re still gonna get old and die,
sents.zh: 在佛陀的故事里，他一开始是个王子，后来他发现这一切都有点没意义，因为人终究还是会老、会死，

sents.t: and then he goes into the woods looking for something more.
sents.zh: 于是他走进森林，去寻找更多的东西。

sents.t: I’ll take the happy route that involves material success. Thank you.
sents.zh: 我还是选那条带着物质成功的快乐之路吧。谢谢。
